title: David the Shepherd Boy, Part 1
body:
with translation by Rabbi Lazer Brody and illustrations by Rebecca Shapiro

 
David the Shepherd Boy, Part 1
 
Hello, dear children.
 
I would like to tell you a wonderful story, an exciting story about the power of believing in Hashem and how Hashem can help you.
 
The story takes place in the days when the great King David, the King of all the Jews, was just a young boy. It was a time before anyone had ever heard of him. The story will describe how David believed in Hashem and prayed all the time to Him, even as a boy. Hashem therefore chose him to rule over the Jewish people.
 
 
To be continued, G-d willing
